case_name: Babu Lal S/O Kishan Lal vs Smt Anita W/O Shri Babu Lal D/O Shri Ram

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Babu Lal S/o Kishan Lal, husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Anita Devi W/o Shri Babu Lal D/o Shri Ram Lal Bairwa, wife

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage between appellant and respondent was solemnized on 23.4.2003. Appellant husband used to torture the respondent wife for bringing motorcycle and money for his business. Respondent's elder sister Kavita was also married with appellant's elder brother Om Prakash.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking maintenance to prove that they are unable to maintain themselves.
legal_principles.held: Even the notices are served, nobody is present on behalf of the respondent wife to argue the matter.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise agreement between the parties can be a valid basis for determining maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Thus, both the petitions were disposed off by compromise that petition u/s 13-B of the Act be filed on 01.09.2012 and appellant shall pay Rs.1,00,000/- for permanent maintenance.

outcome.final_order: Delay of 59 days in filing the appeal is condoned. The application (2080/2018) stands disposed off.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
